entries.58ef5706ed12be65: Transport and Installation of Heavy Cargo
entries.8f860fe9d89fcca6: A comprehensive logistics company founded in the Port of Kobe, centered on port transportation, warehousing, and domestic and international transportation, and also engaged in heavy cargo transport and installation, real estate leasing, and other activities.
entries.aa7a16290f0c9dda: Businesses Requiring Transport of Heavy Cargo
entries.c1db10b90a9c8786: Manufacture and Sale of Alcoholic Beverages
entries.c53fa265bb81e53d: This is a category that brings together businesses other than logistics. It conducts heavy construction machinery works and real estate leasing, as well as alcoholic beverage manufacture and sale, sale and leasing of goods, finance, agricultural product production and sale, solar power generation, and software development, design and maintenance, among others. 6 subsidiaries and 4 affiliates are involved in this business. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,908 million.
entries.f4c89d3a16f0f3c2: It is the core business of the group. It covers port transport, including port cargo handling, operation of container terminals and storage in transit sheds; warehouse business, including storage of cargo and loading and unloading; road freight transport; international transport such as international multimodal transport; and transport overseas, conducted in Japan and overseas. 27 subsidiaries and 14 affiliates are involved in this business. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥260,849 million.
